claims.text: Testing is for significant vomiting or dehydration.
claims.quote: Patients with significant vomiting, signs of dehydration, or both usually require testing.

claims.text: Suspected hyperemesis gravidarum: urine ketones; serum electrolytes if symptoms are severe or persistent.
claims.quote: If hyperemesis gravidarum is suspected, urine ketones are measured; if symptoms are particularly severe or persistent, serum electrolytes are measured.

claims.text: No fetal heart sounds on Doppler: pelvic ultrasound to check the fetus and rule out hydatidiform mole.
claims.quote: If fetal heart sounds are not clearly audible or detected by fetal Doppler, pelvic ultrasound should be done to evaluate fetal status and rule out hydatidiform mole.
